About Us

Leading autonomous test services in Hillsboro, Missouri

Autonomous Test Company delivers comprehensive testing and validation solutions for autonomous vehicles, drones, and robotic systems. Based in Hillsboro, MO, we serve clients across the Midwest with state-of-the-art facilities and expert engineering teams.

We are committed to ensuring the safety, reliability, and performance of autonomous systems through rigorous testing, simulation, and data analysis. Our team brings decades of experience in robotics, AI, and automotive engineering.

"Safety and precision are at the core of everything we do."

Our Services

End-to-end autonomous system testing

Vehicle Testing

Full-spectrum testing for autonomous cars, trucks, and shuttles under reale road conditions.

Simulation

Advanced virtual environments for hardware-in-the-loop and software-in-the-loop simulation.

Data Analysis

In-depth analytics and reporting to validate system performance and identify edge cases.

Safety Validation

Compliance testing, functional safety (ISO 26262), and scenario-based validation.

Sensor Calibration

Precise calibration of LiDAR, cameras, radar, and ultrasonic sensors for accurate perception.

Field Support

On-site testing support, data collection, and telemetry monitoring at our Hillsboro facility.
